## Kody · Business Logic

**[kodus-olimpo/claude-athena#36 · Enrollment fee discount](https://github.com/kodus-olimpo/claude-athena/issues/36)**

<sub>Task read 2026-11-27 23:20 UTC · re-checked on request at `e8a57b6`</sub>

| | Requirement | In this PR |
|---|---|---|
| ✅ **MET** | AC-1: `EnrollmentFeeService.calculateEnrollmentFee` returns the base fee of 500.00 for a student with no sibling enrolled. <sub>AC01</sub> | `src/enrollment/discount-lookup.ts:11` · `applySiblingDiscount` returns the fee unchanged when `siblingsEnrolled <= 0`, so `calculateEnrollmentFee` with the base fee of 500 (declared at src/enrollment/fee.service.ts:9) yields 500.00, with the rounding/clamping at fee.service.ts:14 leaving it intact. · _already in the code, outside this PR's diff_ |
| ✅ **MET** | AC #2: a student with at least one sibling already enrolled gets a 10% discount on the fee (pays 450.00). <sub>AC02</sub> | `src/enrollment/discount-lookup.ts:14` · The untouched helper `applySiblingDiscount` returns the full fee when `siblingsEnrolled <= 0` and otherwise subtracts 10% (`fee - fee * 0.1`), so the fee service's call with BASE_ENROLLMENT_FEE = 500 yields 450.00 for a student with at least one enrolled sibling. · _already in the code, outside this PR's diff_ |
| ✅ **MET** | AC3: the fee is never negative and is rounded to 2 decimals. <sub>AC03</sub> | `src/enrollment/fee.service.ts:14` · The calculated fee is clamped at zero and rounded to two decimals before being returned. |
| ➕ **NOT IN TASK** | Adds school logo SVG path data that the enrollment fee requirements do not ask for. | `src/enrollment/logo-path.ts` · kodus-olimpo/claude-athena#36 doesn't ask for it. · Move it to the task that asks for the school logo, or reference that task in the PR. |
| ➕ **NOT IN TASK** | Adds a `sumDiscounts` helper for an invoice preview, which none of the fee requirements ask for; it also has a loop bound that runs past the end of the array and can produce NaN. | `src/enrollment/discount.ts:10` · kodus-olimpo/claude-athena#36 doesn't ask for it. · Remove it from this PR (or reference the invoice preview task) and fix the loop bound to iterate within the array. |
| ➕ **NOT IN TASK** | Adds student fixture data (identifiers, names, grade levels, sibling counts, scholarship status) for preview scenarios. | `src/enrollment/students-fixture.ts` · kodus-olimpo/claude-athena#36 doesn't ask for it. · The PR author states this fixture serves the #36 enrollment preview; if that preview work is not part of this task, move the fixture to the task that asks for it. |
